parsed.name: Fluke 3000 FC 无线测量系统
parsed.description: Fluke 3000 FC 是一套通过 PC3000 无线适配器与计算机通信的无线测量仪器系统，可包含 3000 FC 无线数字万用表以及温度、电压等测量模块。它适用于实验室中对电压、温度等信号进行远程读取与数据采集。
parsed.description_en: The Fluke 3000 FC is a wireless measurement instrument system that communicates with a computer through a PC3000 wireless adapter. It can include the 3000 FC wireless digital multimeter as well as temperature and voltage measurement modules, and is used in laboratories for remote readout and acquisition of quantities such as voltage and temperature.
